page_title: COM 0-0 CAG | Como v Cagliari 08/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' The current number of shots on goal is 6:2.
90+2' Como fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Here comes a substitution. Ivan Smolcic is given a rest as he is replaced by Mergim Vojvoda (Como).
89' Maximo Perrone (Como) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ivano Pezzuto had an easy-decision to make.
87' Half-chance! Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) plays a pass into the box, but Jean Butez reacts well to snuff out the attack.
86' Now Como have a corner.

85' Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Como are awarded a corner kick.
84' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Nico Paz (Como), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
83' Wonderful movement by Como. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
80' Ivano Pezzuto blows his whistle. Alex Valle (Como) commits a foul after dangerous play.
79' Substitution. Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Matteo Prati walks off.
79' Fabio Pisacane prepares a substitution. Mattia Felici is replaced by Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari).
79' We are about to witness a subsitution. Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) for Adam Obert.
77' Alex Valle (Como) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
76' The free kick from close range, taken by Como, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
75' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jayden Addai walks off the pitch to be replaced by Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como).
74' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Ivano Pezzuto who sees an offensive foul.
71' Martin Baturina loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Jayden Addai (Como).
70' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
68' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Sebastiano Esposito as he is replaced by Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari).
64' Alex Valle (Como) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Ivano Pezzuto blows his whistle and signals a foul after Maximo Perrone (Como) brought his opponent down.
63' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Maxence Caqueret will be replaced by Martin Baturina (Como).
62' Substitution. Anastasios Douvikas (Como) on for Alvaro Morata.
61' Alvaro Morata (Como) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
61' Ivano Pezzuto blows his whistle and it's Yerry Mina (Cagliari) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
61' Adam Obert (Cagliari) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play.
60' Jayden Addai (Como) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
59' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Maxence Caqueret (Como).
59' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) drives a shot towards the bottom left corner from inside the box, but Elia Caprile leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away. Como have been awarded a corner kick.
58' Maxence Caqueret (Como) steps up to send the ball in.

58' The ball is out of play. Como will have a chance to score from a corner. Nico Paz (Como) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
57' Gianluca Gaetano will be replaced by Michel Adopo (Cagliari).
55' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) commits a foul and Ivano Pezzuto immediately signals a free kick.

54' Alvaro Morata (Como) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Elia Caprile to get hold of the ball.
54' Maxence Caqueret (Como) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

53' Maxence Caqueret (Como) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. The linesman points to the corner flag, Como are going to take it.
52' Flag up against Alvaro Morata (Como). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
50' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
49' Jacobo Ramon (Como) commits a rough foul. Ivano Pezzuto stops the game and makes a call.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Assane Diao is replaced by Jesus Rodriguez (Como).
46' The whistle blows and Ivano Pezzuto starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Maxence Caqueret (Como) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
45+2' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Maxence Caqueret (Como) will deliver the corner kick.
40' Alex Valle (Como) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
39' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Jean Butez pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
39' Jayden Addai (Como) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
38' Maxence Caqueret (Como) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
35' Assane Diao (Como) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
34' Elia Caprile (Cagliari) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
34' Looks like Elia Caprile (Cagliari) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
33' A corner kick by Como is thwarted by the well prepared Elia Caprile (Cagliari).
33' Como get a corner. Jayden Addai (Como) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Elia Caprile.
31' Maxence Caqueret (Como) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.

30' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ivano Pezzuto no option but to blow his whistle. Como are awarded a free kick.
28' Nico Paz (Como) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
28' Assane Diao (Como) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
23' Alvaro Morata (Como) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
22' The Cagliari players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Ivano Pezzuto signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to a foul.
21' The Cagliari players halt their celebrations as referee Ivano Pezzuto makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
19' Alex Valle (Como) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him and his teammates, it's into his own goal!

17' Maxence Caqueret (Como) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
17' It looks like Marco Palestra (Cagliari) saw red with that tackle. Ivano Pezzuto won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

17' Como slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
14' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
12' Diego Carlos (Como) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
11' Ivano Pezzuto blows his whistle as Assane Diao (Como) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
9' Half-chance! Alvaro Morata (Como) plays a pass into the box, but Elia Caprile reacts well to snuff out the attack.
9' Maxence Caqueret (Como) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
4' PENALTY APPEAL after Jayden Addai (Como) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
2' Alvaro Morata (Como) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Como will have the kick-off.
Ivano Pezzuto is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
